headline: Analog Devices job posting seeks AI/ML methods for mixed-signal design verification
fact: ADI’s June 11 Staff Design Verification Engineer posting R263414 assigns AI/ML failure clustering, regression triage, anomaly detection and coverage optimization in mixed-signal/UVM verification. Related Shanghai role R262078, dated July 14, explicitly includes analog behavioral models and digital/analog interface checks, with Verilog-AMS/RNM familiarity. Graduate role R266482, dated September 22, assigns agentic AI to testbench development, debug and regression analysis with engineer review; Shanghai preferences include AMS co-simulation. These related hiring mandates are grouped without assuming a shared team or demonstrated production deployment.
